f1.comment: Clicking a finding on the map while its reviewers are filtered out lands on a different finding: `watch(visible)` resets the selection. Un-hide the finding's reviewers in `showFinding` before selecting it.

messages.text: Is this real? The watch only runs when `visible` changes.

Yes. `showFinding` changes `store.tab`, which changes `visible`, so the watcher runs right after. The finding isn't in `visible` because all its reviewers are hidden, so `store.selected` is replaced with `visible[0].id`.

Clicking a finding on the map while its reviewers are filtered out lands on a different finding: `watch(visible)` resets the selection. Un-hide the finding's reviewers in `showFinding` before selecting it.
